title: 💠 Images of at least 4 ballistic missiles from the IRGC Aerospace Force striking the important King Faisal Air Base in Jordan
text:
💠 Images of at least 4 ballistic missiles from the IRGC Aerospace Force striking the important King Faisal Air Base in Jordan"

"🔹Some Arab media outlets, releasing videos, have stated that these images are from the moment Iranian missiles struck their targets in this morning's operation against the Al-Jafr base in Jordan, which American military personnel use to launch attacks on Iran."

"🔹According to these images, despite the extensive activity of defense systems at the aforementioned base, the Iranian missiles successfully bypassed the enemy's defenses and struck their targets with full force.
